items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: I used to go around and play with him sometime.

ctx.x: The Airfax used to play with the banjo player when the Ram and Browns ran trombone over there. Yeah. I told you one day we get a chance to go to Basin Lewis and catch up with him. Oh, yeah. That's right. Yeah. We got a fine clarinet player over there, too, called Warren Bennett.
